items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: Then New Years we went down to Cafe Society with Red Allen downtown.

ctx.x: I sure don't remember but I know it was a helluva record. I'll never forget that. Sy Oliver made the arrangements, yeah. I have them, too.
They always talk about your relationship with Little Albert, Red Allen, that you have been associated with-
I sent to him to come to New York.

items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: Red would teach me, you know, during intermission, take me upstairs and tell me. ... That's the way I learned to play Dixieland.

ctx.x: I was getting ready to say there was another Lenox Avenue. And, where did you first hear him, Henry Red Allen?
I didn't hear him in person. I heard his record.
